# matterjs-server tests: the porting register

matterjs-server commit `0bd06f222a3d51415980022c5f207705de57b8aa` (`matterjsServerCommit`): the 20 test files of the parts the module ports
from it ahead of matter.js — its camera stream management (phase 37). A test of its WebSocket server rather than
of the behaviour the module takes is `excluded` with class `host-server`: go-fabric-server's.
`ported`: the Go tests cover the file's `it` cases; `partial`: they cover some, the note names the rest;
`planned`: not ported yet; `excluded`: left out, with its class. A `ported` or `partial` note's "Left"
names the `it` cases that will not be ported, each with its class and reason. The guard is `make testparity-check`.

| status | files |
| --- | ---: |
| ported | 7 |
| partial | 0 |
| planned | 11 |
| excluded | 2 |
| total | 20 |
